description: This file declares functions related to CUDA cuDNN data types and version information in the ATen library, part of PyTorch's backend for CUDA support.

methods.name: getCudnnDataTypeFromScalarType
methods.description: Converts an at::ScalarType to a cudnnDataType_t suitable for cuDNN operations.

methods.name: getCudnnDataType
methods.description: Retrieves the cuDNN data type corresponding to the tensor's scalar type.

methods.name: cudnn_version
methods.description: Returns the version number of the cuDNN library in use.
